title: Healthcheck Fails on Docker Weekly Image
body:
**Describe the bug**
Container goes unhealthy.  zap-cli fails to run due to a python3 error.


**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

docker run -d -v /home/ubuntu/workspace/Engineering/QA-E2E/engineering-qa-e2e-tests:/zap/wrk:rw owasp/zap2docker-weekly zap.sh -daemon -port 8080 -host 0.0.0.0 -newsession testing -config api.addrs.addr.name=.* -config api.addrs.addr.regex=true -config api.disablekey=true


**Expected behavior**
Healthy Container

**Software versions**
 - ZAP: latest zap-weekly

**Errors from the zap.log file**
See https://github.com/zaproxy/zaproxy/wiki/FAQconfig for the location of the zap.log file for your OS.

**Additional context**


From Docker Inspect

            "Health": {
                "Status": "unhealthy",
                "FailingStreak": 560,
                "Log": [
                    {
                        "Start": "2019-10-15T18:53:05.809999008Z",
                        "End": "2019-10-15T18:53:06.255462353Z",
                        "ExitCode": 1,
                        "Output": "Traceback (most recent call last):\n  File \"/usr/local/bin/zap-cli\", line 11, in <module>\n    sys.exit(cli())\n  File \"/usr/local/lib/python3.6/dist-packages/click/core.py\", line 664, in __call__\n    return self.main(*args, **kwargs)\n  File \"/usr/local/lib/python3.6/dist-packages/click/core.py\", line 621, in main\n    raise RuntimeError('Click will abort further execution '\nRuntimeError: Click will abort further execution because Python 3 was configured to use ASCII as encoding for the environment. Either switch to Python 2 or consult http://click.pocoo.org/python3/ for mitigationsteps.\n"
                    },

From The Container itself.
```console
zap@12d938538e78:/zap$ zap-cli status
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/bin/zap-cli", line 11, in <module>
    sys.exit(cli())
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.6/dist-packages/click/core.py", line 664, in __call__
    return self.main(*args, **kwargs)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.6/dist-packages/click/core.py", line 621, in main
    raise RuntimeError('Click will abort further execution '
RuntimeError: Click will abort further execution because Python 3 was configured to use ASCII as encoding for the environment. Either switch to Python 2 or consult http://click.pocoo.org/python3/ for mitigationsteps.
```

```console
ap@12d938538e78:/zap$ which zap-cli
/usr/local/bin/zap-cli
```

```console
zap@12d938538e78:/zap$ cat /usr/local/bin/zap-cli
#!/usr/bin/python3

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import re
import sys

from zapcli.cli import cli

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.argv[0] = re.sub(r'(-script\.pyw?|\.exe)?$', '', sys.argv[0])
    sys.exit(cli())
```

```console
zap@12d938538e78:/zap$ which python
/usr/bin/python
zap@12d938538e78:/zap$ python --version
Python 2.7.15+
zap@12d938538e78:/zap$ /usr/bin/python3 --version
Python 3.6.8
```

If I change #!/usr/bin/python3 to #!/usr/bin/python the script works again.
